title: RAZEMONEY
tagline: A easy and transparent way to donate money and rewards the donator.
description:
The current issue with donation sites is that donation sites decide who deserves and doesn't deserve a donation. They don't treat everyone equally and take a chunk of money needed for donations. 

With our donation site, we don't control who can ask for money and who can donate. We use a rating system called "Honesty points" to allow users to ask for more donation money. Users are able to gain more Honesty points by showing proof that the funds are used properly. 

When a user donates they receive an nft that has the function to vote on users' Honesty points. If more than 51% of nft holders decided that the funds are going to be used  incorrectly the donation is closed and funds will be sent back
how_its_made:
We are using pologogn as the main network of the site. This would help will cutting transaction cost and allows for users to receive what they ask for excaulty!

Also we are using IPFS to store when users ask for donations, the images associated with those donations and the text that is giving with the donations.
